decisions.reason: The schlager compilation is a low-cost catalog item close to the firm's core offer and was visibly featured on its own page; it fits the announced genre broadening, and in a warehouse-backed catalog there is little reason to delist it.
The illustrated release series embodies the firm's carefully produced editions and public curatorial identity, so the investment and visible commitment favor persisting with it.
Jazz vinyl reissues are central to the firm's long-standing reissue expertise and to the growth of the vinyl market, so any weak sales would be read as temporary and the product kept.
A multi-disc box set ties up substantial production investment and inventory and was showcased on its own page, which strongly encourages keeping it in the catalog until stock sells through.

The compilation CD received only a passing mention and little visible commitment, making it the likeliest to be quietly phased out, but the low cost of keeping catalog items means keeping it is still more likely.
